svg.title: An indexed grid and its actual normal and OR SIXEL output
svg.desc: The original 3 by 6 grid is split into eight color masks or three index-bit masks. Below each mask column is its emitted SIXEL character. The full recorded bodies contain 45 normal bytes and 19 OR bytes; both decode exactly.
svg.text: 18 pixels · 8 palette entries · fast encoding policy
1 Normal: send one mask per color
Each colored square is painted; dots are skipped.
45 body bytes · 170 bytes including header and palette
2 OR: send one mask per index bit
Teal squares turn on a bit; dots leave it unchanged.
19 body bytes · 147 bytes including header and palette
How the first OR column becomes “i”
Both streams decode to exactly the input colors.
